node.statement: Smooth polar-inverse upgrade: for every finite-dimensional exact-unit epsilon_r-C*-algebra and every delta > 0, if lem-stage1-smooth-unitary-atlas gives the smooth embedded atlas and Pi_delta: calU x B^{calH}_delta(J) -> S_delta is the bijective C^1 local diffeomorphism of lem-stage1-polar-retraction onto an open set, then the same ambient-bilinear Pi_delta is a smooth diffeomorphism and its same set-theoretic inverse (u_delta, h_delta) is smooth; no point or first derivative is changed.
